name: Aether Shuriken
notes:
Aether Shuriken
The Aether Shuriken is a deadly and elegant weapon designed for the character, perfectly embodying their speed, precision, and mastery of single-target elimination. These throwing stars are infused with Aether energy, allowing them to return to the wielder after being thrown, ensuring that the character is never without their lethal tools.
When an Aether Shuriken is thrown, it spins through the air with uncanny accuracy, slicing through armor and flesh with ease. The dark, light-absorbing metal of the shuriken contrasts sharply with the glowing runes etched into its surface, which pulse with Aetheric energy as it homes in on its target. Upon impact, the shuriken releases a burst of Aether energy, destabilizing the enemy's defenses before returning to the character's hand, ready for another throw. The Aether Shuriken’s ability to teleport the character directly to the target through Aether Step further amplifies its effectiveness, allowing for swift and deadly follow-up attacks.
With the Aether Shuriken, the character can strike from afar and close the distance in an instant, delivering precise, deadly attacks with relentless efficiency.
Effects
-- Aether-infused throwing stars that return to the wielder after being thrown.

name: Aether Sword
notes:
Aether Sword
The Aether Sword is a weapon of unparalleled craftsmanship, designed for the character to channel Aether energy into devastating strikes. This finely crafted blade is a seamless fusion of advanced materials, intricate design, and potent Aetheric enchantments, making it the ultimate tool for precision and power in combat.
When the character wields the Aether Sword, the blade glows with a radiant blue light, its sharp edge cutting through the air with a hum of Aetheric energy. The runes etched into the blade pulse with power, reflecting the connection between the weapon and its wielder. Each strike with the Aether Sword is enhanced by the Aether Burst ability, which unleashes a concentrated surge of energy upon impact. The resulting explosion of power not only doubles the inflicted wounds but also leaves a glowing trail of devastation in its wake, making each blow potentially fatal.
With the Aether Sword in hand, the character becomes a whirlwind of lethal energy, capable of cutting down enemies with strikes that are as precise as they are powerful.
Effects
-- See below.

name: Assault Slugger
notes:
The Assault Slugger is a heavy automatic weapon that fires metal slugs designed to detonate on impact within the target rather than in an area. It is bulky and functions like a large machine gun. When set to full auto, damage increases significantly, but the operator suffers an attack penalty and consumes four rounds per attack.
With the Assault Slugger, the wielder can tear apart positions and heavy targets.
Effects
— Full auto: increased damage, attack penalty, four shots per attack; slugs detonate on impact (no area rules).

name: Axe
notes:
The Axe is a classic two-handed melee weapon built for raw impact and intimidation. Battle-axes feature a large double head mounted on a stout shaft, delivering devastating chops and cleaving strikes. They remain a staple among frontline fighters and warrior traditions across many worlds.
A typical battle-axe stands three to four feet from grip to blade, with a heavy double-headed design that balances reach and power. The shaft is often reinforced to withstand repeated impacts, while the broad heads are engineered for maximum penetration against armor and flesh alike. In trained hands, the axe can hook shields, break formations, and deliver fight-ending blows.
With the Axe, a warrior can dominate the close fight through sheer force and reach.
Effects
— Large double-headed weapon on a three- to four-foot shaft; may be used two-handed.

name: Bastard Sword
notes: Bastard Sword is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Battleaxe
notes: Battleaxe is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Beak-Mace
notes:
The Beak-Mace is a distinctive melee weapon consisting of a knobby striking ball and a long, beak-like metal spike. The beak can be loaded with up to ten doses of poison, and when the user chooses to inject, a successful hit delivers the dose; the victim suffers poison effects if the attack causes wounding damage. Delivering a poison injection requires a declared attack and incurs a penalty to the attack roll.
The weapon can be used without poison for straightforward blunt and piercing damage, and many warriors reserve poisoned strikes for foes they consider unworthy of honorable combat. The beak’s design allows deep penetration, making it effective for both direct damage and toxin delivery. In the right hands, the Beak-Mace is as much a statement of intent as a tool of war.
The Beak-Mace lets the wielder choose between honorable force and lethal toxin.
Effects
— Beak may hold up to ten poison doses; injection attack at -1d; poison applies if wounding damage results.

name: Bio-Forge Gauntlet
notes:
Bio-Forge Gauntlet
The Bio-Forge Gauntlet is an extraordinarily versatile tool designed for the character, who specializes in biotechnology and technological innovation. This unique gauntlet can shape bioengineered materials into various weapons or tools on the fly, making it an indispensable asset in both combat and the daily functioning of the hive. The gauntlet’s adaptability allows the character to quickly respond to any situation, crafting the necessary tools or weapons in moments.
The Bio-Forge Gauntlet is a sleek, bio-mechanical device that covers the character’s forearm and hand. It is crafted from a lightweight yet durable bio-alloy, with organic elements interwoven throughout its structure. Bioluminescent veins pulse with a soft green glow, indicating the gauntlet’s power levels and readiness. The surface is covered in a network of flexible, tendril-like structures that extend and reshape with a smooth, fluid motion, allowing the gauntlet to morph into various forms. When activated, the gauntlet emits a faint hum, and the tendrils move with a precise, almost organic grace, forming weapons or tools as needed.
The Bio-Forge Gauntlet transforms the character into a formidable and adaptable force, capable of shaping the battlefield and enhancing the hive’s capabilities with unparalleled efficiency.
Effects
-- Can shape bioengineered materials into various weapons or tools on the fly.

name: Bio-Spitter
notes:
The Bio-Spitter filters impurities and waste from its host’s body, and as a weapon, for it can launch the resulting biochemical compounds at an enemy. Compounds are stored in soft egg sacs—one egg per hour—and the spitter holds up to ten. A hit is caustic and potentially deadly.
It can hold up to 10 and can also fire Bormaul Eggs if loaded; each uses two slots. With the Bio-Spitter, the host can turn waste into a weapon.
Effects
— Up to 10 eggs; one per hour; Bormaul Eggs use two slots each. “eggs,”

name: Bio-Vine Whip
notes:
Bio-Vine Whip
Bio-Vine Whip is an extraordinary weapon designed for the character, enabling them to entangle and immobilize enemies with ease. This retractable whip, crafted from bioengineered vines, synergizes perfectly with the character's plant manipulation abilities, providing both offensive and defensive capabilities that enhance their control over the battlefield and their team's safety.
Visually, the Bio-Vine Whip is a marvel of biotechnological innovation and natural beauty. When retracted, it resembles a tightly coiled vine, the length of a forearm, with a handle made from dark, smooth wood-like material that pulses with a soft green bioluminescence. Upon activation, the whip unfurls with a life of its own, extending up to 15 feet as it twists and moves fluidly, almost as if it character alive. The vine’s surface is textured with tiny barbs that can latch onto targets, ensuring they remain ensnared by the whip’s powerful grasp.
The Bio-Vine Whip turns the character into a master of battlefield control, using the living force of nature to bind and immobilize foes.

name: Blaster Cannon
notes:
The Blaster Cannon is a heavy, auto-firing energy weapon built for sustained suppression and area denial. It is typically slung from a shoulder strap and fired from the hip, allowing the operator to lay down a continuous stream of fire while maintaining mobility.
The weapon’s bulk and recoil make aimed single shots impractical; instead, it excels at saturation fire. The power cell and emitter array are oversized compared to smaller blasters, producing a heavier bolt and a higher rate of fire. Hip mounting and bracing are standard, as the cannon is too unwieldy for precise shoulder fire.
With the Blaster Cannon, a single operator can dominate a corridor or hold a position against advancing forces.
Effects
— Heavy auto-firing blaster; normally shoulder-slung and hip-fired.

name: Blaster Carbine
notes:
The Blaster Carbine bridges the gap between sidearm and rifle, offering greater damage and range than a pistol at the cost of size and ease of concealment. It is widely used by irregulars, raiders, and special operations units who need compact firepower without the bulk of a full rifle.
The carbine is somewhat heavier and less forgiving than a pistol, requiring two hands for best accuracy. In return, it delivers a more powerful energy charge and improved effective range. Its compact profile makes it suitable for vehicle crews, boarding actions, and environments where a full-length rifle would be a liability.
The Blaster Carbine remains a go-to choice for anyone who needs serious firepower in a portable package.
Effects
— None

name: Blaster Pistol
notes:
The Blaster Pistol is the standard sidearm for military officers, law enforcement, and starship personnel. Compact and relatively easy to conceal, it provides a reliable backup when heavier weapons are impractical or unavailable.
The pistol’s small frame houses a compact power cell and emitter, producing a modest but effective energy discharge. Its size allows it to be worn at the hip or in a shoulder holster without hindering movement. While it lacks the punch of a carbine or rifle, it is sufficient for close-quarters defense and routine duty.
With the Blaster Pistol, the wielder is never unarmed in a crisis.
Effects
— None

name: Blaster Rifle
notes:
The Blaster Rifle is the standard infantry long arm in most military and paramilitary forces. It requires two hands to fire effectively, though the trigger grip can be rotated for underhand or overhand firing in tight spaces. The rifle’s larger emitter produces a bigger, more ovoid energy charge than pistols or carbines, increasing both damage and effective range.
In the field, the rifle is the backbone of squad-level firepower. Its ergonomics and balance support sustained fire and accurate shots at medium range. The weapon’s profile is familiar across countless worlds, where it serves as the default armament for line troops.
The Blaster Rifle defines the standard of military ranged combat.
Effects
— Two-handed; grip may be rotated for underhand or overhand fire.

name: Bloodblade
notes:
Bloodblade
The Bloodblade is a weapon of dark elegance and immense power, designed specifically for the character, a warrior who thrives on draining the life force of their enemies to heal and empower themselves. This sword is more than just a tool of destruction; it is a conduit for the character's vampiric energy, allowing them to siphon vitality from their foes with every strike, enhancing their own strength and resilience as the battle progresses.
The Bloodblade is forged from a rare, dark metal that glows with a sinister red luminescence, as though it is infused with the essence of blood itself. Intricate runes and vein-like patterns run along the length of the blade, pulsating with an eerie, life-draining energy. When the character wields the Bloodblade, the weapon feels alive in their hands, responding to their every move with a deadly precision. As the blade cuts through flesh and armor, it not only inflicts wounds but also draws life force from the target, feeding it back to the character and healing their own wounds. The more the character strikes, the stronger and more focused they become, each hit fueling their insatiable thirst for vitality.
The Bloodblade is the ultimate expression of the character's predatory nature, a weapon that not only cuts down enemies but also empowers its wielder, allowing them to sustain themselves through the life force of those they defeat.

name: Blowgun
notes:
The Blowgun is one of the simplest missile weapons in use: a long hollow tube that propels a small dart by breath alone. It is common on low-tech and frontier worlds, where its silence and portability make it a favored tool for hunters and covert operatives. Unenhanced darts rarely cause serious injury, but poison-tipped darts turn the blowgun into a deadly stealth weapon.
The tube is lightweight and easy to carry; darts are small and can be carried in quantity. Firing requires no mechanical parts and produces no flash or report, making the weapon ideal for ambush and assassination. In the right environment, a skilled user can deliver a single, nearly undetectable strike.
With the Blowgun, the wielder can strike from concealment without betraying their position.
Effects
— Poison-tipped darts are effective for stealth and assassination.

name: Bormaul Eggs
notes:
Bormaul Eggs can be launched from bio-spitters or thrown by hand. Each egg contains a small crustacean (a bormaul). Normally tough and leathery, death eggs grow fragile when thrown, and break upon impact. When they hit, no damage results (often lulling opponent’s into a false sense of security).
After impact, the bormaul seeks the nearest compatible life form. Once on a victim, the bormaul will squeeze or chew beneath armor and begin feasting on the next round. Bormaul ratings are 8/10/2 and they are small and tough enough to negate most forms of armor. These creatures are completely mindless and will continue to attack until killed.

name: Botanic Grenades
notes:
Botanic Grenades
Botanic Grenades are innovative explosive devices crafted specifically for the character, offering a versatile means of battlefield control. These grenades can release either healing spores to aid allies or toxic spores to debilitate enemies, making them an essential tool for maintaining the balance between life and death on the battlefield.
Each Botanic Grenade is a small, spherical device about the size of a grapefruit, made from bioengineered materials that resemble natural seeds. The outer shell is textured like bark, with bioluminescent veins that pulse softly, indicating the type of spores contained within. When thrown, the grenade bursts open, releasing a cloud of spores that spread quickly through the air. The healing spores emit a gentle, greenish glow as they drift towards allies, mending wounds and restoring vitality. Conversely, the toxic spores darken the air with a sickly yellow hue, spreading their venomous influence to any enemy caught within the cloud.
Botanic Grenades perfectly complement the character's ability to manipulate plant life and maintain the balance between life and death on the battlefield.
Effects
-- Attack is made via Throw or grenade launcher, and the effect is determined by the type of spore released.
-- If no Feat is used, the either 1r of Dmg() as Healing or Dmg(*2) as Dmg as chosen by player
-- If Feat then defer to Feat for effects

name: Bow
notes:
The Bow is a timeless missile weapon still widely used on primitive worlds and by scouts, hunters, and covert operatives. This model stands about four feet unstrung with a draw weight of roughly forty pounds, balancing portability with enough power to pierce armor at short to medium range. Poison-tipped or specially treated arrows make it a potent stealth and assassination tool.
The bow’s simplicity—a flexible stave and a string—belies its effectiveness in the right hands. Arrows can be customized with explosive, incendiary, or other special tips where technology permits. No power cell or mechanism is required, making the weapon reliable in harsh or low-tech environments.
With the Bow, a skilled archer can deliver silent, accurate strikes at a distance.
Effects
— Poison-tipped and other special arrow tips may be used.

name: Bow (Long)
notes: Bow (Long) is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Brawl
notes: Kick, Punch, Bite, GTH, Tail, Tacklet, etc.

name: Caustic Spitter
notes:
The Caustic Spitter is a living weapon harvested from a knotted plant structure. It is formed when certain beetles infest trees and attract nesting spiders. The spider builds a cocoon and uses secretions to lure beetles in, then stores them and its waste.
When threatened, it can expel a glob of caustic waste and beetle parts that sears flesh and scars metal. The liquid nature of the discharge grants +1d damage against partial armor. With the Caustic Spitter, the wielder can deliver a nasty surprise at close range.
Effects
— +1d Dmg against partial armor; single discharge per use.
### **Bioblades**
Bioblades are living melee weapons grown to bond with a specific user and gain combat capability as they mature. If broken or damaged in combat, a bioblade regrows at about one inch per day. They need not be sharpened but must be fed once per week by being placed in rich, damp soil for at least two hours. With Bioblades, the wielder carries a weapon that grows with them and can recover from damage.
Effects
— Regrowth one inch per day; feed weekly in damp soil; no sharpening.
*

name: Chain Whip
notes: Chain Whip is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Channel Crystals
notes:
Channel Crystals are clear, multi-faceted gems with a hollow center, roughly the size of a small grenade.
A channeler may activate these crystals by expending two power points. Once activated the crystal’s center pulsates with the user’s signature color (see powers).
Channel Crystals remain energized for up to one round, and may be thrown during this time.
Crystals inflicting explosive damage equal to the user’s channeler skill rating.

name: Clawed Gauntlets
notes:
Clawed Gauntlets
The Clawed Gauntlets are a set of intricately designed and lethal weapons crafted specifically for the character, enhancing their natural claws to deadly new levels. These gauntlets are not just tools of destruction but extensions of the character's very being, turning their hands into instruments of relentless slaughter. Forged from an ultra-durable, dark metal and engraved with glowing runes, the gauntlets pulse with a fierce red light, reflecting the raw, unbridled fury of the character.
Each gauntlet is fitted with razor-sharp claws capable of slicing through armor and flesh with terrifying ease. The character's natural strength is magnified by the gauntlets, allowing them to deliver powerful, precise strikes that can tear through enemy lines and overwhelm their foes in close combat. The Clawed Gauntlets are more than just weapons; they are a symbol of the character's ferocity and dominance on the battlefield.
When the character engages their foes, the Clawed Gauntlets become a whirlwind of slashing fury, each swipe a deadly arc of destruction. The character moves with brutal efficiency, tearing through enemies as if they character mere obstacles in their path. The Clawed Gauntlets are a perfect embodiment of the character’s savage nature, turning their rage into a weapon of unparalleled lethality.

name: Claymore
notes: Claymore is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Club/Mace
notes:
The Club and Mace are among the oldest melee weapons in use: a weighted head on a shaft, designed to crush and break rather than slice. The mace evolved from the primitive club and remains standard issue in many military and religious orders. Modern versions use a reinforced shaft and a heavy head for maximum impact.
The weapon can be wielded one-handed for speed or two-handed for extra power. The head concentrates force on a small area, making it effective against armor and hardened targets. No edge need be maintained, and the design is simple enough to produce and repair almost anywhere.
With the Club or Mace, the wielder can deliver bone-breaking force with minimal training.
Effects
— Shaft with weighted head; may be used one- or two-handed.

name: Combat Knife
notes:
The Combat Knife is a purpose-built survival and close-combat tool, often regarded as the ultimate field sidearm. It features an eight-inch blade—one edge straight, the other serrated—and a six-inch grip that houses a compact digital compass, self-adjusting for local gravity and capable of displaying positional coordinates. The grip also contains a spool of high-tensile line, emergency rations, a distress beacon, and a small compartment for toxins or other supplies.
When the beacon is activated, it broadcasts to any compatible receiver in range, making the knife a last-resort lifeline for downed personnel. In combat, the blade is fast and versatile, suitable for slashing, stabbing, and utility tasks. The combination of weapon and survival gear has made it a standard issue for elite and long-range units.
The Combat Knife ensures its bearer is never truly unarmed or without a way to call for help.
Effects
— Integrated compass, line, beacon, and storage; blade one-edged and one serrated.

name: Crossbow
notes:
The Crossbow has evolved into a high-performance weapon built from advanced materials, with a prod and mechanism that deliver far greater force than historical designs. Modern versions typically include an integrated bolt magazine and auto-draw system, allowing a bolt to be fired every round without manual spanning. The magazine holds up to twenty bolts and can be loaded with a variety of bolt types.
Bolts may be wood, metal, or composite, and can be fitted with explosive, poison, or other payloads. The weapon is ideal for users who need rifle-like punch without the training curve of a bow, and it performs well in confined spaces. Its ability to hold a drawn state makes it suitable for ambush and overwatch.
With the Crossbow, the wielder can deliver heavy, accurate shots with minimal exposure.
Effects
— 20-bolt capacity; auto-draw allows one bolt per round; various bolt types and payloads.

name: Crystal Guitar
notes: Crystal Guitar is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Crystal Thrower
notes:
Crystal Thrower
The Crystal Thrower is an advanced ranged weapon designed for the character, combining ancient earth-based magic with cutting-edge technology to launch explosive crystal shards. This sleek weapon, resembling a cross between a high-tech rifle and a mystical staff, is crafted from a lightweight alloy with glowing runes etched into its surface. Crystalline structures integrated into the design shimmer and refract light, giving the weapon a mystical, otherworldly appearance that reflects the character's mastery of elemental forces.
When the Crystal Thrower is fired, it emits a sharp, crystalline hum as it charges, followed by the sharp crack of the crystal shards being propelled at high speed. The shards gleam with an inner light, leaving streaks of radiant energy in their wake. Upon impact, the shards embed deeply into the target, followed by a brief moment of silence before they violently detonate, sending a shower of smaller, jagged crystals in all directions. The explosion is accompanied by a sharp, resonant crack, followed by the hissing sound of shards piercing the air, leaving the battlefield littered with glimmering fragments.
With the Crystal Thrower in hand, the character turns precision ranged attacks into deadly, explosive assaults, amplifying their destructive power on the battlefield.

name: Cyber Talons
notes: Cyber Talons are cybernetic implants that extend from the fingers rather than from the back of the hand, offering claw damage and grip enhancement.

name: Dagger
notes:
The Dagger is a short, double-edged blade prized for concealability and lethality at close range. It has long been the weapon of choice for assassins, thieves, and anyone who needs a blade that can be hidden until the last moment. When coated or envenomed, the dagger becomes a one-strike tool of quiet elimination.
The blade is short enough to be worn at the belt, in a boot, or in a sleeve, and can be drawn and used in a single motion. In combat it favors quick thrusts and close grappling. Its reputation as a killer’s weapon is well earned, but it also serves as a universal backup blade for soldiers, scouts, and travelers.
With the Dagger, the wielder is never without a final option when other weapons fail or cannot be used.
Effects
— None

name: Disk Cannon
notes:
The Disk Cannon is a heavy weapon that fires spinning metal disks at high velocity, capable of inflicting severe damage in trained hands. Its massive recoil makes it difficult to control without support; it is typically used with a hip-mounted firing arm that braces the weapon. Without the arm (or an equivalent hard-point mount), the operator suffers a significant attack penalty.
Visually, the cannon is a substantial piece of hardware, with a wide bore and a mechanism designed to impart spin and velocity to each disk. The disks themselves are durable and can cut through light armor and flesh with ease. The weapon is a favorite of heavy infantry and vehicle crews who can afford the weight and the mount.
With the Disk Cannon, a single well-placed shot can decide an engagement.
Effects
— Use of hip firing arm or hard-point mount required to avoid attack penalty.

name: Disk Pistol
notes:
The Disk Pistol is a compact sidearm that fires small spinning disks, commonly issued to military and security personnel who need a concealable sidearm. It is small enough to be hidden under a coat or in a holster and delivers solid damage at close range. The main drawback is its distinctive report—a harsh metallic scrape that is difficult to silence and easy to recognize.
The mechanism that spins and launches the disk is simple and reliable, with fewer moving parts than some energy weapons. The disks are cheap to produce and can be stored in a magazine or speed-loader. For operators who prefer kinetic sidearms and can accept the noise, the Disk Pistol is a dependable choice.
With the Disk Pistol, the wielder has a reliable backup that packs a punch.
Effects
— Noisy when fired; small and easily concealed.

name: Disk Rifle
notes:
The Disk Rifle is the standard-issue long arm for many military forces, firing heavier spinning disks than the disk pistol and at greater range. It is approximately three feet long and incorporates a folding shoulder stock; deploying the stock is important for accuracy, and firing without it (or without a hard-point mount) incurs an attack penalty.
The rifle’s larger mechanism allows for bigger, faster disks that hit harder and penetrate better. Troops trained on the weapon use it for everything from patrol to full-scale engagements. The folding stock makes it easier to carry in vehicles and tight spaces while still providing stability when extended.
The Disk Rifle is the backbone of infantry firepower for forces that favor kinetic disk weapons.
Effects
— Shoulder stock or hard-point mount should be used to avoid attack penalty.

name: Dragon Slayer Spear
notes: Dragon Slayer Spear is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Energy Dagger
notes:
Energy Dagger
The Energy Dagger is a sleek and deadly secondary weapon crafted for the character, designed to deliver precision strikes with lethal efficiency. This dagger is more than just a blade; it is a conduit for Aether energy, capable of releasing powerful bursts of energy at close range, making it an indispensable tool for versatile combat scenarios.
When the character wields the Energy Dagger, the blade shimmers with a faint blue light, its edge razor-sharp and ready to cut through the toughest defenses. The hilt pulses gently with the wielder’s heartbeat, providing a secure grip that feels almost alive. When combined with the Phasing Thrust ability, the Energy Dagger becomes partially intangible, allowing it to bypass armor and other barriers with ease. The blade phases through the target’s defenses, delivering a precise and unavoidable strike that inflicts guaranteed wounds based on the character’s skill.
With the Energy Dagger, the character can execute precise and deadly strikes, cutting through even the most impenetrable defenses with unmatched precision.

name: Executioner’s Axe
notes: Executioner’s Axe is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Eye-Laser
notes:
This laser is implanted in the patient’s head next to an eye. The laser follows all of the user’s eye movements (using targeting computer technology), and is highly accurate. It inflicts only 8L dual damage (see *EM, systems, weapons)* vs normal targets. When used against close stationary items (i.e., to cut) the two barrels slide together forming one beam with a 10M cutting ability. In this form, the beam length is limited to two feet and may not function as a weapon.
### **Quick Attach Weapons**
All of the following are used with (and require) the quick attach couplink. It takes one movement action to attach or detach an item, and a full round to complete switch items.
*

name: Flail
notes: Flail is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Flame Lance
notes:
Flame Lance
Flame Lance is a powerful weapon crafted for the character, specializing in medium-range combat and large-scale enemy mitigation. This plasma-infused lance is engineered to pierce through enemy lines, delivering devastating fiery assaults that amplify the character's natural combat prowess. The Flame Lance not only enhances the character's ability to absorb damage but also transforms them into a relentless force of fiery destruction on the battlefield.
Visually, the Flame Lance is a marvel of advanced technology and lethal design. When not in use, it appears as a compact, cylindrical device made from a heat-resistant alloy with a dark metallic finish. Glowing orange-red lines pulse along its surface, indicating the immense power within. Upon activation, the lance extends to its full length, revealing an 8-foot-long, plasma-infused blade that crackles with fiery energy, ready to unleash its destructive force.
In the heat of battle, the Flame Lance turns the character into a blazing spearhead, capable of tearing through enemy ranks with unmatched ferocity.

name: Focus Blade
notes:
The Focus Blade is a foot-long black cylinder with a deep red gem set in one end. The cylinder is semi-opaque, containing a solid core of pure black. The red stone seems to be the focus point, from which a blade of up to five feet may be extended, coruscating in the user’s signature color.
A channeler who obtains a Focus Blade must power up and imprint the weapon by investing power points. This individual’s power points are reduced by five for one week while the weapon is being imprinted — the weapon cannot be used until this time has passed. After one week, the channeler's power points return to normal.
No one, not even another channeler, may use the same Focus Blade after it has been imprinted by its owner. Focus Blades may be activated by making a skill check vs 5 (failure and success are governed by the exact same rules as channeler enhancements).
The weapon’s Dmg is \+2d above the channeler's relevant skill rating.

name: Force Gauntlet
notes:
The Force Gauntlet is a flexible metal glove fitted with a built-in repulsor field that amplifies the force of each strike. When the gauntlet contacts a target, the field triggers, adding significant impact to what would otherwise be a normal punch. The result is a substantial boost to unarmed damage, making the gauntlet a popular choice for brawlers and close-quarters specialists.
The gauntlet is worn like a glove and does not restrict manual dexterity when not striking. Force gauntlet kits are also available as armor enhancements, allowing the same technology to be integrated into existing gauntlets or vambraces. The field is tuned to activate on impact, so it does not interfere with gripping or manipulation.
With the Force Gauntlet, the wielder’s fist hits like a hammer.
Effects
— +1c to normal punch damage; may be taken as an armor enhancement.

name: Gas-Beetle
notes:
Gas-Beetles are biotech organisms that resemble beetles with large gas-filled sacs beneath their wing cases. When directed, they scurry into an area and release their sacs in a burst of noxious gas; the effect is similar to a gas grenade. Victims who fail the relevant check are incapacitated, choking and retching for a number of rounds equal to their failure.
After use, the beetles return to their host and the gas sac regenerates over a full day. They can follow moderately complex pheromonal orders such as: “Wait at this door. When it opens, enter and bomb the occupants, then run down this hallway.”

name: Geomantic Staff
notes:
Geomantic Staff
The Geomantic Staff is a powerful and mystical weapon designed for the character, blending ancient earth-based magic with cutting-edge technology to channel potent spells and create formidable barriers. This staff, with its shaft crafted from rare wood intertwined with glowing crystalline minerals, pulses with deep, earthy light. The top of the staff is adorned with a large, multifaceted crystal that radiates elemental energy, surrounded by intricate metalwork that enhances its magical properties, symbolizing the character’s deep connection to the earth.
When the Geomantic Staff is wielded, it feels warm and alive in the character’s hands, as if it pulses with the rhythm of the earth itself. As the staff channels earth energy, the crystal atop it glows brightly, casting a warm, amber light across the battlefield. The air around the staff vibrates with a low hum, and the ground beneath the character seems to respond, shifting subtly in resonance with their will. When the staff is used to cast spells or create barriers, the crystal pulses with radiant energy, and the earth itself rises up to obey the character’s commands, forming walls of stone or unleashing blasts of raw elemental power.
The Geomantic Staff is a weapon of unparalleled versatility, empowering the character to dominate the battlefield with both offensive and defensive earth magic, making them an indomitable force.
Effects
-- See below for specific Feats associated with this ability.

name: Giant Maul
notes: Giant Maul is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Glaive
notes: Glaive is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Grasp-Glove
notes:
This squid-like animal slips over the user’s hand (or hand-like appendage), and constricts its wet inner muscles around the user’s forearm.
When used the creature’s tentacles flail out up to two squares away and wrap around any object which the user wishes. Opponents and unwilling targets require a successful attack roll.
If the glove hits, it will pull the target in (Str vs Str) and (upon command) stab it with a spike located in the center of its body for 6L Dmg (no Def allowed).
Each round which the victim is held, the tentacle glove will stab again. The victim must roll their Str vs the tentacle glove’s Str in order to break free. In the meantime, the user can attack the held victim with a \+1c attack bonus.
A tentacle glove will adapt its own Strength to match that of its user so that it will not harm its user. This takes about a week. The tentacle glove can not increase its Str above 10H.

name: Great Axe
notes: Great Axe is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Grenade Launcher, Underbarrel
notes:
The Underbarrel Grenade Launcher, sometimes called a “thumper”, is a compact tube that mounts beneath the barrel of a carbine or larger weapon. A second trigger allows the operator to fire grenades without switching weapons, and the launcher holds up to five rounds. Reloading the magazine is a complete action, so operators must choose when to top off with care.
The launcher extends the primary weapon's versatility, adding area effect and anti-structure capability to a single package. It is widely used by infantry and special operations units who need to deliver grenades quickly without carrying a dedicated launcher. The mounting is sturdy enough to withstand recoil without affecting the host weapon's accuracy.
With the Underbarrel Grenade Launcher, the wielder can answer any threat from personnel to light fortifications.
Effects
— Holds five grenades; reload is a complete action.

name: Guard Beetles
notes:
These small squat beetles are a little over an inch in diameter. The listed price will purchase ten beetles, and a small sac of black puffball seeds. Spike beetles enjoy a symbiotic relationship with puffball plants in which the beetles eat the plant's leaves. In return, spike beetles valiantly guard the plant's fragile fallen seeds.
To use, the sac of seeds is tossed over an area no larger than nine individual squares. The beetles will immediately shuffle off the host and set up watch over the area. Anyone entering will have to deal with the beetles. In place of wings, spike beetles have two long thorn-like spikes tipped with a mild paralytic poison. When any being enters the area, the beetles race out placing their bodies beneath the victim’s feet (rating 8/6/2). Those wounded must make a Fortitude check vs the 10L poison or be slowed to MR 1 for the next hour.
Most beings will take one step per square. Fortunately for the beetles, their shells are tough enough to support 500 lbs, keeping them from being crushed.

name: Halberd
notes: Halberd is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Hand Axe
notes: Hand Axe is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Hand X-Bow
notes:
The Hand X-Bow is a compact crossbow with a pistol grip, designed to fire small metal darts with considerable force from a one-handed frame. It is equipped with an auto-draw mechanism so that the string is spanned automatically after each shot, allowing rapid follow-up fire. Darts can be poison-treated or fitted with special tips in the same way as arrows.
The weapon is small enough to be carried as a sidearm or backup, and its darts are easy to carry in quantity. Optional magazine modules are available, including a 25-dart store similar to that used with magazine bows, for users who want to avoid manual reloading in the field.
With the Hand X-Bow, the wielder has a silent, accurate option that needs no power cell.
Effects
— Auto-draw string; darts may be poisoned or use special tips; optional 25-dart store available.

name: Heavy Crossbow
notes: Heavy Crossbow is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Heavy Flail
notes: Heavy Flail is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Homing Disc
notes:
The Homing Disc is an advanced throwing weapon that combines the principle of a boomerang with homing and anti-grav technology. The disc is gripped through finger holes in the center and thrown like a discus. A built-in homing device and anti-grav unit automatically returns the disc to the wielder’s holster once it comes to a complete stop (i.e., hits its target or stops sliding after a miss).
The disc is typically carried at the hip in a quick-draw pouch; the wielder can ready, throw, and retrieve it in a single round. With the Homing Disc, the wielder can strike and have the weapon back in hand almost instantly.
Effects
— Return to holster after coming to rest; ready, throw, and retrieve in one round.

name: Hydro Flamer
notes:
The Hydro Flamer projects a thin stream of liquid fuel that ignites upon release, creating a short-ranged cone of fire. The stream can reach several squares, and the fuel includes its own oxidizer, so the weapon functions even in vacuum or other oxygen-poor environments. Damage is highest against the first target in the stream and falls off for subsequent targets in the path.
Ammunition is carried in small pressurized bottles that are swapped when empty. The weapon is a favorite of assault troops and anyone who needs to clear confined spaces or suppress areas without relying on explosives. The visual and psychological effect of a continuous flame stream is significant, and the weapon can also be used to deny passage or destroy sensitive matériel.
With the Hydro Flamer, the wielder commands a tongue of fire that burns anywhere.
Effects
— Full damage to first target, half to second, etc.; functions in space; ammo in compressed bottles.

name: Improvised
notes: Improvised is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Inferno Blade
notes:
Inferno Blade
The Inferno Blade is a fearsome melee weapon forged for the character, a frontline combat specialist designed to tear through enemy lines with overwhelming force. This blade channels intense heat, enabling it to slice through armor and flesh with ease. When wielded by the character, the Inferno Blade becomes an instrument of fiery devastation, cutting down foes and absorbing damage in equal measure. The weapon's heat-infused strikes are perfect for close-quarters combat, where the character’s fiery nature and relentless assault shine.
Visually, the Inferno Blade is a striking combination of advanced technology and raw power. The blade's dark metallic surface is interwoven with glowing red-orange lines that pulse with searing heat. Each strike of the blade causes these lines to flare brightly, sending waves of heat across the battlefield. When activated, the blade emits an aura of intense heat, making it both a symbol of the character’s might and a tool of their destructive fury.
As the Inferno Blade cleaves through its enemies, it leaves behind a trail of smoldering carnage, solidifying the character’s dominance on the battlefield.

name: Javelin-Sword
notes:
The Javelin-Sword is a hybrid weapon that appears to be a standard blade but conceals a single-shot projectile launcher in the hilt. Opponents who mistake it for an ordinary sword often pay with their lives when a javelin-like bolt is driven from the tip by an integrated mass driver. The blade itself is unaffected by the bolt’s presence or absence and always functions as a sword.
The bolt is stored within the blade assembly and must be reloaded after each shot; reloading is a complete action. When fired, the bolt uses the same attack and damage ratings as the sword. The weapon thus offers one surprise ranged strike before the fight closes to melee, where it continues to perform as a full sword.
The Javelin-Sword gives the wielder a lethal option at range without sacrificing melee capability.
Effects
— One bolt per reload; reload is a complete action. Bolt uses sword’s Atk and Dmg.

name: Laser Blade
notes:
The Laser Blade is a sword that projects a blade of coherent light from the hilt, adjustable in length from zero to about three feet. An interference grid contains and shapes the beam, allowing it to cut through most materials with ease. The weapon is a favorite of duelists and special operations personnel who need a compact, devastating melee option.
When the blade is retracted, the hilt is easy to carry and conceal. When extended, it can slice through armor, barriers, and flesh. The one limitation is that energy shields and similar defenses disperse the coherent beam, resulting in reduced damage when striking through such fields. Even so, the Laser Blade remains one of the most feared close-quarters weapons in use.
With the Laser Blade, the wielder carries a cutting edge that never dulls.
Effects
— Variable length 0–3 feet; 1c Dmg penalty when attacking through energy fields.

name: Light Crossbow
notes: Light Crossbow is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Living Bow
notes:
Living Bow
Living Bow is an extraordinary weapon designed for the character, embodying the synergy between nature and biotechnological innovation. Crafted from living wood, this bow enables the character to fire arrows imbued with various effects, such as healing or poison, enhancing their ability to control the battlefield and support their allies with precision and versatility.
The Living Bow is a marvel of organic craftsmanship. The bow is constructed from a unique type of living wood, which is both flexible and resilient, with a deep green hue and bioluminescent veins that pulse softly with the life force contained within. The bowstring is made from a durable, sinewy material that adapts to the character's touch, ensuring a smooth and powerful draw. When an arrow is nocked, the bow seems to hum with energy, the veins glowing brighter as it prepares to unleash its life-altering effects upon the target.
With the Living Bow, the character becomes a master of the battlefield, capable of delivering precise strikes that can heal allies or devastate enemies with the power of nature itself.

name: Longsword
notes: Longsword is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Mace (Heavy)
notes: Mace (Heavy) is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Magazine Bow
notes:
The Magazine Bow is an advanced bow that integrates an arrow-storage system into the grip, similar in principle to magazine-fed sidearms. When the bow is drawn to full arch, the store feeds a pre-notched arrow into place, allowing a skilled user to loose two standard arrows per round. The magazine can hold up to fifty arrows in as many as five selected types.
Complex rounds such as explosive-tipped arrows take longer to materialize and are typically limited to one shot per round. The result is a weapon that combines the flexibility of a bow with the sustained fire of a magazine-fed system, favored by elite scouts and special units who need high output without sacrificing arrow variety.
The Magazine Bow turns the ancient bow into a modern volume weapon.
Effects
— Up to 50 arrows, five varieties; two normal arrows per round; complex arrows once per round.

name: Microgrenade Launcher
notes:
Despite the name “micro,” the Microgrenade Launcher is a large, shoulder-mounted system that fires compact grenades in volume.
A microgrenade is a high tech version of a standard grenade. They contain a special switch which is activated when the microgrenade exits the launcher’s barrel.; they cannot be set by hand and must be fired from the launcher. They are smaller and often cheaper than standard grenades due to mass production.
The launcher is a favorite of heavy infantry and assault units who need sustained area fire. With the Microgrenade Launcher, the wielder can dominate a zone with a mix of effects.
Effects
— Four magazines, 12 rounds each; microgrenades arm on launch only; see Ammo for types and costs.

name: Missile Launcher
notes:
The Missile Launcher is a shoulder-fired tube that accepts a variety of missile types for long-range, high-yield strikes. When purchased, it typically comes with two standard explosive missiles; additional or specialized missiles are bought separately. The launcher's main advantage is a small protective field that shields the operator's hand and arm during launch, reducing backblast and debris injury.
The weapon can fire any compatible missile type, from standard high-explosive to guided or specialty rounds. It is a staple of anti-armor and fire-support teams who need to reach out and destroy hardened targets. Reloading is a deliberate process, so operators usually work in pairs or with a loader when sustained fire is expected.
With the Missile Launcher, the wielder can deliver decisive force at long range.
Effects
— Ships with two standard missiles; other types purchased separately; protective field during launch.

name: Morningstar
notes: Morningstar is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Nano-Blade
notes:
Nano-Blade
The Nano-Blade is an advanced weapon designed for the character, allowing for silent and precise eliminations during stealth operations. This retractable, mono-molecular blade is engineered for maximum lethality, enabling the character to strike with unmatched precision while remaining undetected.
As the character grips the handle of the Nano-Blade, the weapon hums softly before the ultra-thin blade extends with a barely audible whisper. The blade, almost invisible to the naked eye, glows faintly with a bluish hue, reflecting the high-tech energy coursing through it. With a swift and fluid motion, the character brings the blade down on their target, slicing through armor and flesh with ease, leaving no sound but the quiet hum of the weapon retracting into its hilt.
The Nano-Blade allows the character to blend into the shadows, executing lethal strikes with surgical precision and vanishing without a trace.
Effects
-- Retractable mono-molecular blade designed for silent takedowns.

name: Needler
notes: The Needler is a small, cone-shaped creature which affixes itself to any desired spot on its user’s body. Upon command, the creature will spit out tiny, razor-sharp needlers. If a needler causes wounding damage, it will burrow beneath the flesh and head for the victim’s heart. This causes 6L additional Dmg each round unless cut out (for additional Dmg equal to all taken so far). Medtechs can remove a needler on a roll equal to the number of rounds the needler has been burrowing. An individual with first aid needs roll equal to all Dmg taken so far in order to remove the needler.

name: Neon Skateboard
notes: Neon Skateboard is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Nuke
notes: Nuke is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Phase Rifle
notes:
Phase Rifle
The Phase Rifle is a state-of-the-art energy weapon designed for the character, excelling in long-range reconnaissance and precision elimination. This rifle offers unparalleled accuracy and versatility, making it an essential tool for stealth and tactical operations, whether striking from afar or delivering wide-area energy bursts to maximize battlefield impact.
When the Phase Rifle is activated, the character feels the weapon hum with power, the barrel glowing faintly as energy accumulates within. The rifle's sleek, matte-black surface absorbs the light, making it nearly invisible in the shadows, while iridescent accents shimmer when exposed to direct light. As the character peers through the digital scope, the holographic display provides real-time data, adjusting for wind speed, distance, and target movement. With a steady hand, the character squeezes the trigger, sending a focused beam of energy streaking through the air, leaving a brief, luminescent trail before striking its mark with pinpoint accuracy.
The Phase Rifle transforms the character into a long-range assassin, delivering death from the shadows with silent, unerring precision.
Effects
-- Long-range energy rifle
-- Provides real-time feedback on ammunition, energy levels, and targeting.

name: Pike
notes: Pike is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Pipe Wrench
notes: Pipe Wrench is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Plasma Gauntlets
notes:
Plasma Gauntlets
The Plasma Gauntlets are formidable weapons engineered for the character, a warrior known for their relentless assault and battlefield dominance. These gauntlets deliver superheated plasma punches, making them ideal for breaking through enemy lines and delivering devastating, fiery attacks. The Plasma Gauntlets are more than just weapons—they are an extension of the character’s strength, turning every punch into an explosion of heat and power that incinerates anything in its path.
The design of the Plasma Gauntlets is both functional and intimidating. Each gauntlet is crafted from a dark, heat-resistant alloy, adorned with glowing red-orange circuitry that pulses with plasma energy. When activated, the gauntlets emit a bright, fiery glow, with superheated plasma crackling around the fists. Each strike is accompanied by a burst of flame and energy, making the Plasma Gauntlets a fearsome tool of destruction on the battlefield.
In the hands of the character, the Plasma Gauntlets become unstoppable instruments of fiery annihilation.

name: Plasma Sword
notes:
The Plasma Sword projects a three-foot blade of superheated plasma contained by a magnetized field. Anything that contacts the blade is seared instantly, making it one of the most destructive melee weapons in use.
When deactivated, the weapon collapses to a compact grip roughly eight inches long. Power is supplied by either a waist-mounted precipitator pack or disposable plasma capsules. With the Plasma Sword, the wielder carries a blade that never dulls and cuts through almost anything.
Effects
— Powered by precipitator pack or plasma capsules; blade length 3 feet; see equipment for power options.

name: Polearm
notes: Polearm is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Pulse Laser Cannon
notes:
The Pulse Laser Cannon is the heaviest application of pulse-laser technology, firing a thick, sustained beam that can inflict massive damage. The weapon is typically hip-fired due to its size and recoil, and the report is near-deafening—stealth is not an option. It is used by heavy weapons teams and vehicle gunners who need to destroy hardened targets or suppress large areas.
The beam is broader and more powerful than that of pulse rifles or pistols, with a correspondingly larger power draw and heat signature. In the field, the cannon defines the high end of man-portable energy weapons, often deployed in static or semi-static positions where its weight and power requirements can be supported.
With the Pulse Laser Cannon, the wielder brings the maximum available pulse-laser firepower to the fight.
Effects
— None

name: Pulse Laser Carbine
notes:
The Pulse Laser Carbine is a heavier, more powerful version of the pulse pistol, offering better range and damage in a package that remains compact enough for scouts and mobile troops. It is a favorite of units that need to move fast while still delivering serious energy-weapon firepower. The carbine balances portability with output, making it a common choice for forward observers, scouts, and special operations.
The weapon fires the same type of pulsed beam as the pistol and rifle but at an intermediate intensity. Its size allows it to be carried in vehicles and used in confined spaces where a full rifle would be cumbersome. Reload and maintenance are straightforward, and the carbine is widely available across military and paramilitary markets.
With the Pulse Laser Carbine, the wielder has a strong blend of mobility and punch.
Effects
— None

name: Pulse Laser Pistol
notes: Small, compact and deadly, pulse pistols are relatively quiet (although the excitation of air molecules from the beam’s passage makes a soft “pop” sound), pulse pistols are excellent weapons for covert operatives and assassins. Legitimate uses include officers’ side-arms and weapons for security guards.

name: Pulse Laser Rifle
notes:
The Pulse Laser Rifle is issued to veteran and elite units, offering higher energy output and range than the pulse pistol or carbine. The stronger beam produces a louder report, making the rifle a poor choice for covert work but an excellent one for open engagement. It has become a standard armament for many professional and military forces.
With the Pulse Laser Rifle, the wielder brings serious firepower to the front line.
Effects
— None

name: Quad Launcher
notes:
The Quad Launcher is a shoulder-mounted weapon that holds four missiles and requires a hard point for mounting. The operator can fire missiles one at a time, in pairs, or all four in a single salvo. Missile types and effects vary; see ammunition rules for options. When multiple missiles are fired, resolve the attack as for a single shot but multiply wounding damage by the number of missiles that hit.
The ability to ripple-fire or dump the full load makes it flexible for both suppression and killing high-value targets. In the field, the Quad Launcher is a statement of intent.
With the Quad Launcher, the wielder can saturate a target or spread fire across a formation.
Effects
— Hard point required; four missiles; fire one, two, or all four; wounding damage multiplied by number of missiles fired.

name: Quad-Disk Cannon
notes:
The Quad-Disk Cannon is a four-barrel variant of the disk cannon, firing all four barrels at once to deliver devastating damage in a single salvo. Like the single-barrel version, it is used with a hip-mounted firing arm or hard-point mount; without it, the operator suffers an attack penalty due to recoil and weight.
The weapon’s profile is bulkier and heavier than a standard disk cannon, with four aligned barrels that spin and release disks in unison. The result is a weapon of overwhelming short-range firepower, often used to breach positions or destroy high-value targets. Reload and maintenance are more demanding, but the payoff is raw destructive force.
The Quad-Disk Cannon turns a single trigger pull into a storm of spinning metal.
Effects
— Firing arm or hard-point mount required to avoid attack penalty; four barrels fire simultaneously.

name: Quarterstaff
notes: Quarterstaff is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Rage Axe
notes:
Rage Axe
The Rage Axe is a fearsome weapon designed to harness the raw power of the character, amplifying their fury into devastating strikes capable of cleaving through anything in their path. This massive axe is more than just a tool of war; it is an extension of the character’s primal rage, channeled into each swing with unrelenting force. The blade, forged from a dark, gleaming metal that pulses with inner fire, is adorned with carvings of snarling beasts and ancient runes that glow with a fierce, crimson light.
The Rage Axe is designed for maximum destruction, with each swing delivering immense damage that can shatter armor, shields, and bones with ease. The enchanted wood handle provides both balance and grip, ensuring that the character can wield the axe with deadly precision, even in the thick of battle. The Rage Axe is not just a weapon; it is a symbol of the character's indomitable will and their capacity for destruction.
As the character swings the Rage Axe, the air around them seems to crackle with energy, the sheer force of their attacks sending shockwaves through the battlefield. The Rage Axe is a tool of absolute devastation, capable of turning the tide of battle with a single, well-placed strike. It is a weapon that embodies the character’s unyielding spirit and their relentless pursuit of victory.

name: Red Whip
notes:
Red Whip
The Red Whip is an extraordinary and versatile weapon crafted for the character, a front-line combatant who excels in draining the life force of enemies to heal and empower themselves. This flexible, energy-based whip is designed to entangle and drain life from multiple enemies simultaneously, making it an ideal tool for the character’s vampiric abilities and close-combat prowess.
The Red Whip is a marvel of advanced technology and dark magic, with a handle made from dark, polished metal adorned with glowing runes that pulse with vibrant red and violet energy. The whip itself is a flexible strand of plasma contained within a magnetic field, giving it an ethereal, luminescent appearance. When activated, the whip crackles with latent power, extending up to 10 feet and lashing out with deadly precision. Upon striking a target, the whip inflicts necrosis, a powerful condition that causes the target’s vitality to drain away over time, steadily weakening them unless they receive advanced medical attention. Each successive strike compounds the necrosis effect, increasing the rate of vitality loss and making the Red Whip a truly terrifying weapon.
As the character wields the Red Whip in battle, the weapon’s energy pulses with each strike, sapping the life force of its victims and leaving them to wither away. The whip’s flexibility allows the character to strike from unexpected angles, entangling multiple foes and draining their life force simultaneously. The Red Whip’s necrotic effect ensures that even the most resilient enemies will eventually succumb to its relentless drain, making it a powerful tool for any character who seeks to dominate their foes through a slow, agonizing death.

name: Reinforced Bite
notes:
During this operation two hydraulic units are set into the jaw on each side. This gives the jaw \+1c Dmg when the bite attack is used.
The teeth are capped with plasteel to prevent fracturing as the hydraulics clamp down. The jaw is also reinforced with titanium wires to ensure that it will hold when biting into its victim.
Two teeth on top and bottom of each side of the mouth are replaced with pure titanium and set into the jaw as further insurance against fracture.

name: Return-Sickle
notes:
The Return-Sickle is a small, S-shaped throwing weapon that folds into an L-shape for storage. Once it strikes or misses a target, an integrated anti-grav field traces its flight path and returns it to the wielder, who can catch it easily. The weapon can typically be drawn, thrown, and retrieved in a single attack action.
The sickle is compact enough to carry in a belt or harness and is favored by operatives who want a reusable thrown option without the bulk of a full-sized weapon. The return mechanism makes it ideal for hit-and-run and multiple targets in sequence. In the right hands, the Return-Sickle is both tool and statement.
With the Return-Sickle, the wielder can strike at range and have the weapon back without closing.
Effects
— Return to wielder after strike or miss; draw, throw, and retrieve in one Atk action.

name: Rift Blade
notes:
Rift Blade
The Rift Blade is a short, lethal weapon designed for the character, perfectly suited for close-quarters combat and spellcasting. Infused with void energy, the blade enhances the character's ability to channel the raw power of the void, allowing them to cast devastating spells and maintain control over the battlefield. The Rift Blade is a fusion of dark elegance and deadly power, its very presence exuding an aura of menace.
When the character wields the Rift Blade, the weapon seems to drink in the light, its dark metal surface shimmering with an ethereal glow. Intricate void runes etched along the blade pulse with deep purple light, casting eerie reflections on nearby surfaces. As the character strikes, the blade leaves behind a trail of shadowy energy that crackles and snaps in the air. The weapon hums with barely contained power, resonating with the character’s intent and amplifying their control over the void. To those who face the Rift Blade, it appears as if the character is wielding a piece of the void itself, capable of severing the ties between reality and oblivion.
The Rift Blade is not just a weapon; it is a conduit for the character's immense power, turning each strike into an opportunity to bend the battlefield to their will.

name: Rotary Plasma Gun
notes:
The Rotary Plasma Gun mounts six barrels that spin as they fire, each spitting a mass of white-hot plasma. The barrels are cooled by a liquid nitrogen jacket. The weapon is supplied by a plasma precipitator pack (see equipment); the same pack can power a plasma sword or other plasma devices.
The gun must be spun up for one full round before it can be fired safely; firing before the barrels reach optimal rotation risks burning them out if damage rolls are high. When activated, the gun emits a constant hum or whine that is clearly audible nearby. With the Rotary Plasma Gun, the wielder brings maximum plasma firepower to the fight.
Effects
— One full round to spin up before use; early fire can burn out barrels; precipitator pack powers weapon and other plasma gear.

name: Scimitar
notes: Scimitar is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Seeker Rifle
notes:
The Seeker Rifle is a slender, long-barreled weapon that fires small guided projectiles capable of curving around corners and over obstacles to strike targets that would be protected from line-of-sight fire. The projectiles are less destructive than full seeker missiles but share the same homing principle, making the rifle ideal for engaging foes in cover or behind partial concealment.
The rifle negates defense modifiers that would apply from partial cover, as the rounds can adjust their trajectory to find a path to the target. This makes it a favorite of urban fighters and anyone who regularly faces entrenched or sheltered opponents. The trade-off is limited payload and the need for a clear initial lock.
With the Seeker Rifle, the wielder can hit what others cannot even see.
Effects
— Homing projectiles; negates defense modifiers for partial cover.

name: Serrated Maul
notes:
The Serrated Maul is a fearsome two-handed pole weapon, nearly seven feet from end to end, that combines the reach of a spear with the cutting power of multiple blades. The head is a mass of barbs, flanges, and edges designed to cut and tear rather than simply pierce. It is favored by warriors who want to dominate reach and leave lasting wounds.
High-quality Serrated Mauls are often forged with labor-intensive methods—repeated folding and tempering of the steel—to produce blades that hold an edge and resist shattering. The result is a weapon that can hook, slash, and impale in a single fluid motion. Its size demands two hands and significant strength, but in return it offers unmatched presence in the melee.
The Serrated Maul turns every swing into a statement of intent.
Effects
— Two-handed; multi-bladed head for cutting and tearing.

name: Shadow Orb
notes:
Shadow Orb
The Shadow Orb is an enigmatic and powerful weapon designed for the character, serving as both a focus for their spells and a tool for controlling the battlefield. This floating orb enhances the character’s ability to harness void energy, unleashing bursts of dark power that weaken enemy formations and turn the tide of battle. The orb is a mesmerizing sphere of dark, translucent crystal that absorbs and refracts light, its surface constantly shifting with shadowy tendrils of void energy.
When the character summons the Shadow Orb, it hovers effortlessly by their side, its dark surface swirling with an ever-changing pattern of darkness and light. The orb seems almost alive, pulsing with void energy that resonates with the character’s intentions. As it floats through the air, it leaves a faint trail of shadowy mist in its wake, the void energy within crackling softly like distant thunder. When the character releases a bolt of void energy from the orb, the dark projectile streaks through the air like a bolt of lightning, striking with deadly precision and devastating power. To allies and enemies alike, the Shadow Orb is a symbol of the character’s mastery over the void, a weapon of both beauty and terror.
The Shadow Orb is not just a weapon but an extension of the character’s will, turning the raw energy of the void into a tool of both destruction and control.

name: Short Sword
notes: Short Sword is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Shoulder-Blades
notes:
Shoulder-Blades are semi-circular blades that are partially implanted in the patient’s shoulder or leg. The blades are made of an ultra-light alloy, and are equipped with a tracking system (much like a targeting computer \- see *EM, tech equipment*).
When the user issues a mental command, a blade will fly out to strike a designated opponent. After use, the blade may be retrieved and reattached.
Shoulder-Blades are a common cyber implant; some users mount several at once.

name: Shredder Cannon
notes:
The Shredder Cannon is a two-handed weapon that fires spinning crescents of metal, related in principle to disk weapons but optimized for shredding and area damage. It is durable and bulky; in a pinch it can be used as a club in melee, dealing set damage with the same attack roll as when fired. Operators favor it for the gruesome wounds and psychological impact it creates.
The weapon is too heavy for one-handed use and requires a committed grip. The crescents spin through the air and tear through light armor and flesh, making it effective against grouped or unarmored targets. Reload and maintenance are straightforward, and the Shredder Cannon has become a standard option for troops who want maximum close-range devastation.
With the Shredder Cannon, the wielder can turn a corridor or breach into a killing zone.
Effects
— May be used as club in melee for 10L damage (same attack roll as when shot).

name: Sickle
notes: Sickle is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Siege Fist
notes:
This massive appendage is designed to do maximum punch damage. During the operation, the patient’s forearm is removed and the cyber fist is attached in its place.
The fist has an outer weighted sheath which can be mentally commanded to slide down and over the user’s knuckles. This sheath contains several sturdy spikes to aid in the blow.
It is a horrible thing when a cyber lord activates their cyber-fist, and opponents have come to dread the sound of the sheath as it slides forward.
A cyber-fist increases punch damage by \+2d with the sheath back and \+1c when it is slid forward.
The fists’s fingers are equipped with joint locks and power joints (double any grip type Str roll).
This fist also adds \+1 to a character’s vitality maximum, but has no impact upon the character’s Vitality rating.

name: Siege Hammer
notes: Siege Hammer is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Silenced Plasma Pistol
notes:
Silenced Plasma Pistol
The Silenced Plasma Pistol is an advanced sidearm engineered for the character, optimized for stealth and close-quarters combat. This compact weapon is designed to fire energy rounds with lethal precision while maintaining the utmost silence, making it indispensable for covert operations and missions that require remaining undetected.
When the character draws the Silenced Plasma Pistol, the weapon’s matte black surface absorbs the surrounding light, allowing it to blend seamlessly into the shadows. The pistol emits a soft hum as it charges, but when fired, the energy round exits the barrel with barely a whisper, leaving only a faint blue trail in its wake. The shot lands with pinpoint accuracy, incapacitating the target without alerting others in the vicinity. The ergonomic grip ensures the character can maintain control even in the heat of battle, allowing for swift and silent eliminations.
The Silenced Plasma Pistol empowers the character to strike from the shadows, executing their missions with deadly efficiency and leaving no trace behind.
Effects
-- Silent, energy-based sidearm designed for stealth and close-quarters combat.

name: Sonic Disrupter
notes:
A sonic disrupter sets up atomic-level vibrations in solid objects, which causes molecular bonds to break down and matter to literally shake apart. The device was designed for use against fortifications (walls, doors, bulk heads, etc.) and terrain obstacles (trees, boulders, etc.) but is gaining popularity with the Guild marines for use against heavily armored opponents, and light vehicles.
The denser the object, the greater the damage (GM’ discretion). Boulders and solid steel walls often result in damage as high as 6LV (the maximum this weapon can cause). When used against rigid armor, damage matches the opponent's AR rating. Thus, if the opponent is wearing 16 (or 8M) armor, the disrupter causes 8M damage. If attached to a power supply, this weapon draws 20 srg per shot regardless of the target or damage rating.
Against less dense or rigid armor, the weapon only causes half as much damage.
Each time the disrupter exceeds the armor value of a target, it permanently reduces the armor value by 1d (Natural Armor is exempt from this rule) although the disrupters damage maintains at the armor's original AR.

name: Sonic Sword
notes:
The Sonic Sword appears as a small hand grip until activated, when three prongs at the base generate a vibrating field of air molecules that extends about three feet. The blade damages targets by disrupting their molecular structure. It can also be used against stationary obstacles—walls, doors—by holding the blade in contact; the weapon inflicts cumulative damage each round until the object is destroyed, though the object may explode when broken, dealing damage based on its AR.
In vacuum or underwater, the blade can detonate for 6Mx damage under certain conditions. The weapon is a favorite of breachers and duelists who want a blade that can cut through almost anything and double as a door-killer. Care must be taken when destroying objects to avoid the backlash.
With the Sonic Sword, the wielder carries a blade that shakes matter apart.
Effects
— Three-foot vibrating field; cumulative damage vs stationary objects; possible detonation in space/water; destroyed objects may explode for AR-based damage.

name: Spear
notes:
The Spear has changed little in principle since its earliest use: a long shaft with a pointed head, for thrusting and throwing. Modern versions use durable alloys for the shaft and head, making them nearly unbreakable under normal use. They remain a staple on low-tech and frontier worlds, used for hunting, militia duty, and combat.
The spear offers reach and versatility—it can be thrown or used in melee, and formations of spears can hold ground against heavier opponents. Its simplicity makes it easy to produce and repair almost anywhere. In the right hands, the spear is both tool and weapon, as effective in the field as in the line.
With the Spear, the wielder has reach and penetration in one package.
Effects
— None

name: Spore Blaster
notes:
Spore Blaster
The Spore Blaster is an advanced ranged weapon designed for the character, a master of biotechnology focused on technological support and innovation. This unique weapon fires concentrated spores capable of entangling enemies or delivering bioelectric shocks, making it perfect for both offensive and defensive operations. The Spore Blaster leverages the character’s expertise in biotechnology, turning them into a formidable presence on the battlefield and a crucial asset to the hive.
The Spore Blaster is a sleek and intricate device, combining organic and mechanical components in a seamless design. The main body of the weapon is constructed from a lightweight, durable bio-polymer, with a surface that mimics the texture of living tissue. Bioluminescent veins run along the length of the weapon, pulsing with a soft green glow that indicates its readiness and the potency of the spores within. When fired, the weapon emits a low, resonant hum, followed by the sudden release of spores that swirl and coalesce into a dense cloud before striking their target with pinpoint accuracy.
The Spore Blaster exemplifies the character’s ability to manipulate the environment, turning the very air around their enemies into a weapon of entrapment and shock.
Effects
-- Fires concentrated spores with special effects.
-- The weapon is both offensive and defensive.

name: Strangle Spear
notes: To an outside observer, this weapon would resemble a poorly carved wooden spear. In reality, when this living weapon hits its target (inflicting 10L damage), it immediately transforms into a sinuous, ropy strand which will attempt to loop around and strangle its victim. This strangling attack is made at the spear’s rating (10/16/1). If it hits, it will use its Str (16 or 8M) vs the victim's FR in an attempt to strangle the victim. If successful the victim begins suffocating. Victims may attempt to break free each round (Str check vs the spear's Str of 16 (8M)).|

name: Stun
notes:
The Stun is a compact handheld weapon that uses focused sound waves to overwhelm the nervous system and knock targets unconscious. Attack rolls are made normally; effect is resolved against the target's WP rather than AR. If the roll exceeds the target's WP, the victim falls unconscious for a number of rounds equal to the margin of success. Beings who cannot hear or who wear protective headgear receive a bonus to their WP when resisting.
With the Stun, the wielder can drop a foe without drawing blood.
Effects
— Effect vs WP; success margin = rounds unconscious; deaf or helmeted targets get +1c to WP.

name: Sun-Blades
notes:
The Sun-Blades are a paired set of exotic blades forged from a metal that naturally stores solar energy and releases it as a powerful shock when triggered. The blades are detachable and can be left in direct sunlight to recharge; after at least a half-hour in full sun, each blade can deliver one stun discharge. The wielder releases the stored energy by depressing a hidden stud, and the target must resist or be stunned for a number of rounds equal to the failure.
If both blades are charged and set to discharge at once, the combined effect is more severe. The weapon is unusual in appearance and requires discipline to maintain and employ, but it offers a non-lethal option that can end a fight without bloodshed. Many warrior traditions prize the Sun-Blades for their blend of martial elegance and tactical flexibility.
The Sun-Blades turn sunlight into a weapon that can drop an opponent in an instant.
Effects
— Each blade stores one stun; release via hidden stud; target resists or is stunned (rounds = failure). Simultaneous discharge from both blades increases effect. Recharge in full sunlight for at least 30 minutes.

name: Sword
notes:
The Sword is the standard melee blade in most systems: approximately three feet of blade on a one-handed grip, used for cutting and thrusting. It has been the sidearm of choice for militant orders and soldiers across countless worlds. Swords are especially valued in confined or sensitive environments—such as ship-boarding—where ranged or explosive weapons would risk collateral damage.
The blade is versatile enough for both slashing and stabbing and can be paired with a shield or off-hand tool. Quality varies from mass-produced issue blades to masterwork pieces. Power-enhanced variants exist at higher cost, adding reactive or electrical elements that increase damage when activated.
With the Sword, the wielder has a reliable, universal melee option.
Effects
— None
* Power enhanced swords are also available at a greatly “enhanced” price — double the listed price. When enhanced, a sword is fitted with a reactive solenoid which will cause the sword’s blade to lung out outward several inches if the tip experiences pressure (i.e., when stabbed into a target).
