The blade is also fitted with an electro-net. The net and solenoid may be activated by depressing a small button mounted on the weapon’s hilt. When activated all attacks cause an extra \+1d of damage.
The Guild is just now outfitting other medieval style weapons with power enhancements. These weapons will be released soon (as determined by your GM). All such weapons will cost twice their listed price and add \+1d to Dmg when the power enhancement is activated. (GM, only light and medium damage weapons may be so enhanced).

name: Tail Spikes
notes:
Some species remove the tail at birth; others retain it. Those who keep their tails can benefit from the tail spike implant.
Other races may only take this implant if they already have tails and a tail attack.
During this operation the tip of the tail is removed and the stump is plated. A power hinge connects the tip to the plated section and the entire process is equipped with spikes.
Tail spikes enhance a patient’s normal tail damage, increasing it by \+1c.

name: Talon-Spear
notes:
The Talon-Spear is a five-foot pole with three spring-loaded talons at one end. A rope or cord can be attached for retrieval after throwing.
The weapon may be used like a common spear. However, if the shaft is twisted, the talons widen and are spring set. When a ta-oon hits after being so set, the talons spring together. The victim may then be “reeled in” like some hapless fish. If unwilling a Str contest between attacker and victim must be made. If the weaker Str exceeds the amount of damage, the ta-oon slips out inflicting half again as much damage.
The weapon has spread to many warrior cultures.

name: Thermite Grenades
notes:
Thermite Grenades
Thermite Grenades are high-temperature incendiary devices designed for the character, a specialist in heavy assault and group combat. These grenades release a searing thermite compound upon detonation, making them perfect for breaking through enemy lines and delivering powerful fiery attacks. The Thermite Grenades are an essential tool in the character’s arsenal, turning them into a force of fiery destruction that can incinerate anything in their path.
Each Thermite Grenade is a compact, cylindrical device encased in a dark, heat-resistant alloy. The surface is etched with glowing red-orange lines that pulse with energy, indicating the volatile thermite compound inside. When activated, the grenade emits a bright, fiery glow before detonating in an explosion of intense heat and flame. The resulting firestorm is capable of reducing armor, flesh, and fortifications to ash, making Thermite Grenades a terrifying weapon on the battlefield.
In the hands of the character, Thermite Grenades become instruments of merciless incineration, leaving nothing but scorched earth in their wake.
Effects
-- Thermite Grenades release a high-temperature incendiary compound upon detonation.
-- Atk is made via Throw or using a grenade launcher.

name: Thorn Gauntlets
notes:
Thorn Gauntlets
Thorn Gauntlets are a pair of cybernetically enhanced gloves designed for the character, providing a versatile and deadly weapon that complements the character’s ability to manipulate plant life. These gauntlets are engineered to project hardened thorns for close combat, ensuring that the character can maintain battlefield control and defense while enhancing their close-quarters combat capabilities.
The Thorn Gauntlets are a seamless blend of nature and technology, crafted from a durable, lightweight alloy with an outer layer of bioengineered plant fibers. The fibers are interwoven with bioluminescent veins that pulse with a soft green light, indicating the gauntlets’ readiness. When activated, the gauntlets extend sharp, durable thorns from the knuckles, transforming the wearer’s fists into deadly weapons. Each strike from the gauntlets is accompanied by a satisfying crunch as the thorns pierce through armor and flesh, leaving the enemy reeling from the impact.
With Thorn Gauntlets, the character wields the power of nature itself in close combat, ensuring that no enemy can stand in their way.

name: Throw
notes:
Throw
This is every race's ability to pick up an good sized rock or steel ball, etc. and throw it.
Improvise: If the object is not a good natural object to throw, then the Improvised weapons should be used.
Good Thrown Items includes grenades, good sized rocks, and similar items, but does not include hurled weapons listed on the tech weapons table hereafter.

name: Throw Object
notes: Throw Object is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Throwing Axes
notes:
Throwing Axes
The Throwing Axes are finely crafted, lightweight weapons designed specifically for the character, combining their ferocity with precision and versatility in ranged combat. These axes are perfect for breaking enemy lines from a distance, allowing the character to strike with deadly accuracy before closing in for the kill. Each axe is meticulously balanced for perfect throws and enchanted to return to the character after being thrown, making them a reliable and reusable tool in any battle.
Forged from resilient dark metal, the blades shimmer with a faint, red luminescence, hinting at the latent power within. The handles are wrapped in grip-enhancing material, ensuring a secure hold even in the most intense combat situations. The axes are adorned with intricate runes that pulse with energy, enhancing their performance and ensuring that each throw is as deadly as the last.
In the hands of the character, the Throwing Axes become more than just weapons; they are an extension of the character’s will, cutting down enemies with precision and power. The ability to retrieve the axes after each throw ensures that the character is never without a weapon, making them a constant threat from any range.
Effects
-- Lightweight, finely crafted axes designed for ranged attacks (poor at melee).
-- Enchanted to return to the character after being thrown.
-- Not designed for melee; if used in melee, Atk(/2) and Dmg(/2).

name: Throwing Knives (set)
notes: Throwing Knives (set) is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Toothed Dagger
notes:
The Toothed Dagger is a long-bladed knife with one sharp edge and one deliberately jagged edge, designed to tear and saw as well as slice. It is the close-combat equivalent of a standard dagger in many warrior cultures, favored by experts who know how to maximize its unique profile. In skilled hands, the weapon can inflict severe and messy wounds.
The blade is long enough to offer reach and penetration while remaining compact enough to carry and draw quickly. The toothed edge can catch on armor or flesh, creating additional trauma on withdrawal. The weapon has spread beyond its culture of origin and is now used by anyone who wants a dagger with extra bite.
With the Toothed Dagger, the wielder carries a blade that cuts twice—going in and coming out.
Effects
— None

name: Tower Crossbow
notes: Tower Crossbow is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Trident
notes: Trident is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Trip-Stave
notes:
The Trip-Stave is a two-handed pole weapon designed for control and versatility rather than raw lethality. It allows the wielder to choose before each attack whether to trip, disarm, or wound an opponent, making it a favorite of duelists and tactical fighters who prefer to dictate the flow of combat.
When used to trip, the defender must succeed on a Def check or be knocked prone. When used to disarm, the defender may resist with either Def or Atk, and failure costs them their weapon. A standard damaging attack is resolved normally. The user must declare the intended outcome before rolling.
The Trip-Stave rewards skill and foresight, turning each exchange into a calculated choice.
Effects
— Trip, disarm, or damage: declare before attack; trip uses Def check, disarm allows Def or Atk to resist.

name: Vampiric Claws
notes:
Vampiric Claws
The Vampiric Claws are a set of retractable, razor-sharp weapons designed for the character, a fierce combatant who thrives on draining the life force of enemies to heal and empower themselves. These claws are more than just physical weapons; they are extensions of the character's vampiric abilities, enabling quick, lethal strikes and facilitating potent life drain.
The Vampiric Claws are sleek, elegant, and terrifying in appearance, crafted from a dark, flexible leather that conforms perfectly to the wearer’s hands. When retracted, the claws are concealed within the gloves, appearing as seamless extensions of the character’s hands. Upon activation, the claws extend to approximately eight inches, gleaming with a faint, blood-red hue. As the character strikes with the claws, they not only inflict physical wounds but also draw upon the life force of their enemies, feeding it back into the character’s own vitality. Each successful strike with the Vampiric Claws enhances the character’s strength, making them more formidable with every attack.
The Vampiric Claws are the embodiment of the character’s predatory nature, allowing them to strike swiftly and drain the life force of their enemies, fueling their own power and ensuring their survival in the heat of battle.

name: Venom Injector Carbine
notes:
Venom Injector Carbine
The Venom Injector Carbine is a bio-tech shooting weapon designed for the character, capable of firing projectiles infused with a potent venom derived from bioengineered flora and fauna. This carbine is versatile, designed for both lethal and non-lethal combat scenarios, delivering effects ranging from paralysis to lethal toxicity. The Venom Injector Carbine has an organic, almost alien aesthetic, with sleek lines and a bioengineered texture that seems to pulse with life.
The carbine’s body appears to be grown rather than manufactured, with components that blend seamlessly into one another. The surface is smooth and cool to the touch, with bioluminescent patterns that shift and change as the weapon charges. When fired, the carbine emits a low, throbbing hum, followed by a sharp hiss as the venom-laced bio-darts are launched at the target. The darts themselves are sleek and needle-like, designed to penetrate armor and deliver their toxic payload deep within the target's body. Upon impact, the venom takes immediate effect, spreading rapidly through the bloodstream and causing a range of debilitating effects.
The Venom Injector Carbine is a potent weapon in the character’s arsenal, turning each shot into a potentially lethal strike that can incapacitate or kill with precision.
Effects
-- Fires bio-darts. Darts can Atk\Mng normally or (see below) may be infused with lethal and nonlethal stim.
-- The basic cartridge causes low Dmg().
-- May be used to shoot targets ensnared by Entangling Burst.

name: Venom Tail
notes:
The Venom Tail is a large muscular implant that sits on the abdomen and has three stinger-tipped tails. The tails can attack one opponent per round—in front, to the sides, or behind the host. Each stinger can hold up to ten doses of poison; natural poison sacs can be added for an extra cost to manufacture paralysis poison at a set rate. With the Venom Tail, the host can strike from multiple angles and deliver toxins in close combat.
Effects
— Three tails; one opponent per round; up to ten poison doses per stinger; optional natural poison sacs (see equipment).

name: Void Sphere
notes:
The Void Sphere is a tiny hollow sphere, about the size of a cherry, that opens a localized rift when activated and thrown. A channeler must expend two power points to activate the sphere, then may throw it at a target. On impact, the sphere shatters and implodes, creating a brief wash of energy that seems to tear a small hole in reality itself.
Anyone within one square of the impact point must resist with Strength against the channeler's skill roll. Those who fail are pulled into the implosion and vanish; their fate and destination are unknown. The sphere is a weapon of last resort or absolute elimination, used when the user is willing to spend significant power and accept the moral weight of permanent removal.
The Void Sphere offers a way to make a problem disappear—literally.
Effects
— Two power points to activate; throw at target; Strength check for those within one square of impact; failure means victim is drawn in and removed.

name: Void Staff
notes:
Void Staff
The Void Staff is a formidable weapon designed for the character, a powerful spellcaster who specializes in large combat group mitigation and magical offense. This staff is imbued with void energy, capable of amplifying spells to devastating effect, making it an essential tool for controlling the battlefield and weakening enemy formations. The Void Staff is a striking blend of otherworldly elegance and dark power, its shaft crafted from a rare, dark crystal that pulses with void energy.
When the character wields the Void Staff, the dark crystal shaft absorbs the ambient light, giving the weapon a shadowy, translucent appearance. Swirling patterns of deep purple and black run along the length of the staff, pulsing with a faint, eerie glow that seems to sync with the character’s own heartbeat. The top of the staff is crowned with a large void crystal, radiating an aura of raw, untamed energy that crackles and hums with potential power. As the character channels their spells through the staff, the void energy intensifies, creating a cascading effect of dark light that engulfs the battlefield. To onlookers, the character appears as a conduit for the void itself, their power amplified by the Void Staff, capable of casting spells with unmatched force and precision.
The Void Staff is not merely a weapon but a symbol of the character's dominion over the arcane, turning the raw energy of the void into a force of overwhelming power.

name: War-Crescent
notes:
The War-Crescent is a two-handed weapon in the shape of a broad metal crescent, studded with additional points and edges. It is a symbol of martial tradition in many cultures and is taught in dedicated schools of combat. The blades and flanges can be used to hook, slice, pin, or restrain—some styles emphasize non-lethal control, while others focus on lethal close combat.
The weapon demands two hands for full effect; using it one-handed incurs a significant penalty to both attack and damage. In the hands of a trained wielder, the War-Crescent is a versatile and intimidating presence, capable of controlling the flow of a duel or cutting down multiple opponents. Its distinctive shape and weight make it unmistakable on the battlefield.
The War-Crescent rewards discipline and practice with devastating versatility.
Effects
— Two-handed; one-handed use incurs -2d Atk and Dmg penalty.

name: Warhammer
notes: Warhammer is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: WarPick
notes: WarPick is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Warrior Claws
notes:
Warrior Claws are three metal blades mounted on a forearm harness and extending from between the fingers. The blades can be retracted into the sheath at will so the wearer can use the hand normally when not fighting. When extended, they deliver serious damage in close combat and can slash or stab in a single motion.
The harness is durable and does not restrict wrist or finger movement when the claws are sheathed. Many close-quarters specialists favor the claws for their speed and the ability to go from unarmed to armed in an instant. The weapon is a statement of intent as much as a tool—visible when extended, invisible when not.
With Warrior Claws, the wielder is never unarmed in the clinch.
Effects
— Retract/extend at will; three blades; considerable close combat damage.

name: WarScythe
notes: WarScythe is engineered with high-durability composite materials for reliable field operations.

name: Web-Ball
notes:
The Web-Ball looks like a six-inch diameter sponge and functions as a defensive weapon. Sponge balls may be tossed or rolled. When tossed, the sponge ball explodes if it hits something; when rolled, the sponge ball waits until it comes to a stop to explode.
When a sponge ball explodes, hundreds of streamers of sticky web-like slime squirt out in all directions up to two squares away. Those streamers contacting surfaces instantly adhere and become rigid, but remain sticky (much like a spider web).
Anyone attempting to force their way through the strands must overcome an 8M strength per square or become hopelessly stuck in the streamers. A square can also be cleared out if 16 points of damage are inflicted. Pulse lasers, projectile weapons and blasters inflict half damage to the strands as so much of the area is empty space.
Physical attacks (such as blows, melee weapons, etc.) causing less than 16 damage become stuck at 16 vs ST. Sponge balls and their strands are particularly susceptible to acid (+1c Dmg). If a sponge ball is destroyed before exploding, all effects are avoided. Sponge balls have a 5/2/0 (Str 16\) rating and once used they die.

name: Web-Launcher
notes:
This creature is a long worm, which forms a cocoon-like home on its host’s body. Upon command, the slinger flings out a ball of sticky, web like material.
If the attack succeeds, the web mass has hit and will burst into a shower of long, gluey runners which spread out across the victim (affects one target only). The web mass has a strong sickening sweet smell which is known to gag many victims.
The entire experience is a horrible sensation like being dipped in a vat of honey covered string.
The web’s Str is 6H. Victims who don't break free (Str vs 6H) are immobilized and may not move, although they may attempt to break free each round thereafter.
A victim may be cut free by allies if a total of 24 points of damage is caused to the web. Webs are not affected by blunt damage weapons, however acid causes \+1c Dmg to the web.
